name: SWEEP-S1v1 Identical eight
_design: Divergence test: 8 identical Haiku agents, same instruction and stats, on an 8-fold symmetric ring in an empty 15x15 world; a tree on every start point plus 6 more. Thinking costs ~2.5x default (~5.7 compute per decision); fruit 18 net. Question: do identical agents diverge into different strategies?
